@@U00650@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00651@@
He thought he had love in his belly!

@@U00653@@
(Sings.)

@@U00654@@
He scampered in, He scampered out, He lapped up puddles With his fuzzy snout; He tore up the house, He gnawed at the door, He scratched and rolled Around on the floor. He hopped and pranced, His pain was so great, But it did him no good, Early or late. He thought he had love in his belly.

@@U00656@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00657@@
He thought he had love in his belly!

@@U00659@@
(Sings.)

@@U00660@@
In terror he ran straight Into the kitchen In the light of day, Twistin and twitchin’, And lay on the hearth, And started to shake, As if his little Rat’s heart would break. The murderess rose up And started to gloat: “Ha, he’s tuning His last note! As if he had love in his belly.”

@@U00662@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00663@@
As if he had love in his belly.
translation:
@@U00650@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00651@@
他以为他肚子里有爱情！

@@U00653@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00654@@
他蹦蹦跳跳地进来，他蹦蹦跳跳地出去，他用毛茸茸的鼻子舔舐水坑；他撕毁了房子，他咬着门，他在地板上抓挠、打滚。他又蹦又跳，他的痛苦如此之大，但这对他没有好处，无论早晚。他以为他肚子里有爱。

@@U00656@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00657@@
他以为他肚子里有爱情！

@@U00659@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00660@@
在恐惧中，他径直跑进厨房，在白天，扭动着，躺在壁炉边，开始颤抖，仿佛他的小老鼠的心要碎了。凶手站了起来，幸灾乐祸地说道：“哈，他正在调最后一个音符！好像他肚子里有爱情一样。”

@@U00662@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00663@@
仿佛他的肚子里藏着爱情。
